explication: TensorRT-LLM is an inference framework for large language and visual-generation models, combining a Python runtime with specialized GPU kernels. The main request path is user input through model execution to generated output; cache management supports efficient serving, while visual-generation pipelines provide a distinct generation path. The README establishes these product capabilities, but the sampled source excerpts are partial and do not expose all runtime wiring, so several subsystem links are intentionally omitted.
